# Gross sales lie. Profit per stop doesn't.

> Free calculator for independent vending machine route operators: find real profit per location after commission, card fees, shrink, drive time, and machine cost, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
